summary: Vistance Networks filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting director Joanne M. Maguire's immediate retirement (no disagreement) and declaring a one-time special cash distribution of $5.00 per share, paid August 27, 2026, to stockholders of record August 17, 2026. Because the distribution is at least 25% of stock value, the ex-dividend date is August 28, 2026, per Nasdaq Rule 11140(b)(2). Expected U.S. tax treatment is return of capital to basis, then capital gain; Form 8937 to be filed within 45 days. Watch for tax characterization updates and potential stock price adjustment.
